resources.string: Export your organizer preferences to a local file, or restore a backup you previously created.
Create a local JSON backup of categories, category order, overrides, favourites and hidden apps. App labels, icons and Android scan data are not included.
Choose a One UI Organizer backup. It will be fully checked before you are asked to replace your current organizer state.
This file is not a valid One UI Organizer backup. Nothing was changed.
This backup was created with a format version this app does not support. Nothing was changed.
The selected backup could not be read. Nothing was changed.
The backup could not be written to the selected file.
The organizer state could not be replaced. Your previous state remains unchanged.
Import replaces all current organizer-owned preferences in one operation. Installed apps and Android system data are not changed.
